name: Delhi
notes: Buildings, storeys, land use, streets, water, and the substations come from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL).
Population: 2011 Census of India, NCT of Delhi (no census has been held since; the real figure is now well above this), spread over residential floor area.
98 % of buildings have no storey count in OpenStreetMap; theirs is estimated from tagged neighbours.

Service areas are split by nearest grid substation, not from real feeder maps. Only 54 grid substations inside the city are mapped in OpenStreetMap (the real network has many more), so each area is large.
Cars: about 200 per 1,000 people, 3 % of them electric today (approximate).
Delhi Metro runs on 25 kV AC overhead lines; AC traction is not modelled yet, so this city has City Day and the other models but no metro page.
Scaled so a summer weekday peaks at 8,748 MW, Delhi’s all-time record set on 29 June 2026 (State Load Dispatch Centre).
